title: 1RB0LC_0LC1RF_1LE1RD_0RC1RC_0LA1LA_---1RA: halting is exactly a Euclid coincidence, and no congruence modulo M ≤ 10,000 can rule it out
text: Lean now proves that the machine halts exactly when its U/V map meets an event with both numbers even and b − a equal to 4 or −2 (halts_iff_coincidence); any event with b = 1 leads to a halt, whatever a mod 4 is (halts_iff_b1). It also proves that for every modulus M up to 10,000 the orbit itself visits the residues (letter, a mod M, b mod M) of such an event within 105 passes, so no congruence argument modulo such an M can show the machine never halts (no_residue_proof). b − a is equidistributed modulo 2j3i and changes sign, so there is no lower bound on it either.
